glm-5.3.description: GLM 5.3 — standard tier, 744B parameters, exposes `reasoning_effort: true` on the live catalog. Text-only (no `modalities` field in the API response). GLM-5.3-licensed; model card https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3. No vendor-documented recommended/default model exists (per https://platform.inco.ai/docs), so this id was chosen editorially as the catalog default for its reasoning capability and mid-range pricing among the roster. Pricing per unauthenticated GET https://api.inco.ai/v1/models (2026-09-28, HTTP 200): $1.40 / $4.40 per MTok input/output, $0.26 cached input.

errorRules.message: Invalid Inco API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}
Inco model '{model}' not found. Pick a current model from the public /v1/models roster or {setupUrl}
Inco rate limit exceeded (per-minute cap or monthly spend cap). Wait and retry, or check your plan at {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://platform.inco.ai/waitlist and request access — Inco is currently waitlist-gated, not open signup; existing users sign in at https://platform.inco.ai/sign-in
2. Once approved, create an API key on the dashboard's Keys page (https://platform.inco.ai/keys) — it is shown in full only once and starts with sk-inco-
3. Add prepaid credit before use: billing is strictly pay-per-token with no free tier, and a zero balance returns HTTP 402 (`credit_balance_exhausted`) until you top up
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint at https://api.inco.ai/v1 (per vendor docs, also reachable via an Anthropic-SDK-shaped API at the host root https://api.inco.ai). The public model catalog (GET /v1/models) is fetchable without a key — confirmed live 2026-09-28, HTTP 200 with 10 models. Access to a working key is currently gated by a waitlist (https://platform.inco.ai/waitlist), and billing is strictly prepaid pay-per-token with no stated free tier (https://platform.inco.ai/docs#limits).
